text: A woman, likely late teens to early twenties, with olive skin, long dark brown wavy hair, and an oval face featuring defined eyebrows and full lips. She wears a deep purple, floor-length gown with sheer sleeves, a V-neckline, and a black belt with gold trim. The dress has side slits. She stands barefoot in profile, arms slightly outstretched, facing right. Other panels show her from front, back, and side angles, plus close-ups of eyes, lips, hair, ears, and face expressions.
